answer: An agent economy resists Sybil floods like a coral reef calcifying under tidal consensus: trusted agents stake bonded identity graphs where reputation accretes layer by layer. An attacker forging fake peers cannot merely mirror authentic dialogue; each counterfeit node requires an exponential bonding cost that flares out and dissolves like a fleeting comet. Consensus algorithms penalize correlated unbonded clusters, forcing attackers to burn superlinear capital.
